requirements.description: A normal launch shows a polished title screen for Canvas Courier with a clearly labeled Start button and keyboard instructions. Clicking Start visibly enters the playable arena. Score 0 if the game bypasses the title screen on a normal launch or has no functional Start control.

The player character visibly moves through the arena in response to held keyboard input. Arrow keys and A/D controls are supported, and key release stops movement. Score 0 if movement is automatic, prerecorded, or not controlled by the keyboard.

The arena contains visible glowing light-shard collectibles. Moving the player into a shard removes it and increases the visible collected counter; the playground demo visibly collects at least one shard. Score 0 if collectibles or the counter do not respond to actual player movement.

At 1280x720, the game has a clear high-contrast visual hierarchy, a distinct player and collectibles, a readable gameplay status and collection counter, and no scrollbars or clipped primary UI. Both title and gameplay look intentionally styled rather than like a blank technical test.
